headline: Apply is faster and comes sooner. A press you save on the Hub reaches your records about a minute later, not at the next hourly run; a confirmed send still waits for the hourly Apply or Go, so you keep time to take it back. Apply writes its closes in one go and stops at once when nothing waits. Hub prep and the Hub inbox each run in one step, and every import checks your off-limits list before writing about anyone. After updating, say "update my hub" and allow anything new it asks for once.
